events.name: OFFSETX
events.comment: X offset for the ground blocks.

events.name: OFFSETY
events.comment: Y offset for the ground blocks.

events.name: SCORE_MEDIUM
events.comment: After this amount of points the game switches to medium difficulty.

events.name: SCORE_HARD
events.comment: After this amount of points the game switches to hard difficulty.

events.name: DEADLY_RATIO
events.comment: How many deadly blocks can appear, given the current amount of spawned blocks.

events.name: DEADLY_START
events.comment: Start spawning deadly blocks when the player reaches this score.

events.name: DEADLY_PROBABILITY
events.comment: Probability of a given block becoming deadly (out of 10).

events.name: GROUND_MOVEMENT
events.comment: How much the ground moves when the player moves.

events.name: BONUS_SCORE
events.comment: When the player reaches this score, a bonus time pickup appears.

events.name: BONUS_TIME
events.comment: Time to be added when the player picks up the bonus time item.

events.name: jumpTime
events.comment: Time taken to perform a jump

events.name: inputsEnabled
events.comment: Can the player control the character?
